description: Given the sign of a composite Sun and a composite Moon (the Sun and Moon of the chart two people make together, not either person's own signs), returns the pair's Tandem name and its one-line description. Takes no personal details.

moon.description: The composite Moon's sign, such as Taurus.

sun.description: The composite Sun's sign, such as Aquarius.

name: tandem_name_for_signs
title: Tandem name for a composite Sun and Moon
